pr169.body:
## Why
Quds had a scoped English/German thesaurus and an initial provider checkpoint, but the remote working branch did not yet contain the complete packs, editor workflow or qualification evidence.

## What this completes
- Bundle all 107,519 regular OEWN 2025 English meaning groups and 50,264 visible OpenThesaurus German groups in 23.44 MiB of verified, lazily loaded assets.
- Preserve source identities, separate meanings, glosses/examples/usage labels and related concepts. Keep lookup language overrides separate from document language.
- Add the Review action, context-menu action and Shift+F7 dialog. Users explicitly select a returned alternative and press Replace.
- Bind replacement to captured source text, story, rich metadata, language, selection, controller revision, provider revision and lookup generation. Reject stale or protected targets and keep replacement in one undo/redo unit.
- Include a deterministic compiler, original pinned source archives, compressed/logical integrity checks, source notices and regeneration instructions. Independent code remains MIT; English retains CC BY 4.0/WordNet terms and German uses the selected CC BY-SA 4.0 option.
- Fix high-polysemy cache thrashing by increasing the bounded parsed-shard cache to 64 entries, with a regression that bypasses result caching.

## Local validation
**155 targeted cases passed:** 5 Python compiler cases, 24 pure-Dart provider cases and 126 native Flutter cases (18 dialog, 51 controller, 42 existing correction/capture/context, 11 review-pane, 1 real bundled-pack panel containing 15 queries, and 3 visual fixtures).

Targeted analysis and release web compilation passed. All 1,037 pack files and generated Dart manifest constants were byte-identical in an isolated rebuild. Final native execution and web compilation bind unchanged source/asset inventories using the verified official Flutter 3.47.8 / Dart 3.13.7 runtime.

Warm native provider p95, bypassing result caching, measured 2.766 ms English and 0.306 ms German on the recorded host. Cold English examples were approximately 0.9–1.4 seconds; these measurements are not browser or installed-release guarantees.

## Remaining release checks
- [ ] Actual offline-browser execution, CSP behavior and browser performance. Local Chromium was blocked by the sandbox's Unix-socket restriction; the supported cloud browser could not reach the local fixture. Compilation passed.
- [ ] Installed native desktop packaging/acceptance. Headless native tests and rendered dialogs passed; the environment lacks the Linux compiler/GTK setup.
- [ ] Independent human linguistic review of lexical quality.

Morphology remains bounded; there is no automatic grammatical agreement, general reinflection or contextual sense selection.

## Evidence and integration scope
[Continuation report and replayable evidence](https://github.com/CrispStrobe/quds_office_suite/blob/315beeb3b2967787e27a3d510d758abfb04c6de6/docs/validation/thesaurus-20261118/continuation/README.md) includes exact counts, hashes, commands, raw logs, source inventories, screenshots, earlier attempts and limitations.

This branch retains the previously reconciled Office/proofing/Zotero baseline and its original integration audit. The continuation starts at decde779; the 155 cases above qualify this thesaurus continuation and its targeted regressions, not the entire repository. No GitHub Actions result was used as a substitute for local evidence.
